senses.en: full of dull, overused statements that pretend to be deep

example.en: His speech was platitudinous and inspired no one.
example.zh: 他的演讲陈词滥调，没有人受到鼓舞。

senses.en: covered with hair; hairy

example.en: He grew a hirsute beard during the expedition.
example.zh: 探险期间他长出了浓密的胡子。

senses.en: amounts of money asked for goods or services

example.en: The bank has raised its service charges this year.
example.zh: 银行今年提高了服务费用。

senses.en: formal accusations of wrongdoing

example.en: The police filed charges against the suspect yesterday.
example.zh: 警方昨天对嫌疑人提出了指控。

senses.en: a wise and respected person

example.en: The old sage offered advice to anyone who visited him.
example.zh: 那位年迈的智者给每一位来访者提供建议。

senses.en: a herb with grey-green leaves used to flavor food

example.en: She added fresh sage to the chicken before roasting it.
example.zh: 她在烤鸡前加入了新鲜的鼠尾草。

senses.en: wise, especially through long experience

example.en: He gave some sage advice about choosing a career.
example.zh: 他给出了一些关于择业的明智建议。

senses.en: a small silvery sea fish common in northern waters, often eaten salted or smoked

example.en: Herring is often served pickled in Northern Europe.
example.zh: 在北欧，鲱鱼常以腌制方式食用。

senses.en: (old-fashioned, especially US) a bar or tavern where alcoholic drinks are served

example.en: In old western films, cowboys often drink in saloons.
example.zh: 在西部老电影里，牛仔们常常在酒馆里喝酒。

senses.en: (British) a sedan car with a closed body and separate boot

example.en: They bought a new family saloon last year.
example.zh: 他们去年买了一辆新的家用三厢轿车。

senses.en: to fight against or refuse to accept something

example.en: The villagers resisted the plan to build a road through the forest.
example.zh: 村民们抵制了在森林中修路的计划。

senses.en: to remain undamaged or unaffected by something

example.en: This fabric resists water and stains.
example.zh: 这种布料防水防污。

senses.en: to stop yourself from doing something you want to do

example.en: She resisted the urge to check her phone during the meeting.
example.zh: 她忍住了在开会时看手机的冲动。

senses.en: one program or section that is part of a broadcast or story series
senses.zh: （系列节目或故事中的）一集，一节

example.en: We watched the first episode of the new series.
example.zh: 我们看了新系列的第一集。

senses.en: a distinct event or period within a longer series of events
senses.zh: （一系列事件中的）一段经历，一段时期

example.en: That winter was a difficult episode in his life.
example.zh: 那个冬天是他人生中一段艰难的时期。

senses.en: a short period when symptoms or a condition occur

example.en: She described a brief episode of dizziness.
example.zh: 她描述了短暂的眩晕发作。

senses.en: Very fast, or happening in a short period of time.
senses.zh: 迅速的；快速的；短时间内的

example.en: The city saw rapid growth after the new railway opened.
example.zh: 新铁路开通后，这座城市经历了快速增长。

senses.en: A part of a river where the water flows very fast, often over rocks.

example.en: The boat slowed as it approached the rapids.
example.zh: 船靠近急流时减慢了速度。

senses.en: to take something away or off from a place

example.en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
example.zh: 进门前请脱鞋。

senses.en: to dismiss someone from a job or position

example.en: The manager was removed from his post.
example.zh: 经理被免职了。

senses.en: living or growing in nature and not tamed or cultivated by people

example.en: Wild animals roam freely in the forest.
example.zh: 野生动物在森林里自由活动。

senses.en: very excited, uncontrolled, or extreme

example.en: The crowd went wild when the band appeared.
example.zh: 乐队出现时，人群沸腾了。

senses.en: a natural, uncultivated area or environment

example.en: Many animals survive better in the wild than in captivity.
example.zh: 许多动物在野外比在圈养环境中生存得更好。

senses.en: likely to hurt or harm someone or something
senses.zh: 危险的；可能造成伤害的

example.en: The broken stairs are dangerous for children.
example.zh: 破损的楼梯对儿童很危险。

senses.en: to take part in a contest or game and try to win

example.en: She will compete in the final race tomorrow.
example.zh: 她明天将参加决赛。

senses.en: to try to be more successful than other people or businesses

example.en: Small shops must compete with large chains.
example.zh: 小商店必须与大型连锁店竞争。

senses.en: the process of decay, often with a bad smell

example.en: Rot had damaged the wooden door.
example.zh: 腐朽已使这扇木门受损。

senses.en: to decay gradually and become soft or bad

example.en: Left in the damp cellar, the wood slowly rotted away.
example.zh: 木头放在潮湿的地下室里慢慢腐朽了。

senses.en: nonsense; silly talk (informal)

example.en: Don't listen to him — that's complete rot.
example.zh: 别听他的，那纯属胡说。

senses.en: a cylindrical part that moves up and down inside a tube to transfer force, as in an engine or pump

example.en: The piston moves up and down inside the cylinder.
example.zh: 活塞在汽缸内上下运动。

senses.en: on top of; at the top of

example.en: The flag flies atop the hill.
example.zh: 旗帜飘扬在山顶上。

senses.en: on or at the top

example.en: The cat sat atop, watching everything below.
example.zh: 猫坐在顶上，俯视下面的一切。

senses.en: a person who gives money or support to something

example.en: She has been a regular contributor to the charity for years.
example.zh: 多年来她一直是这个慈善机构的定期捐助者。

senses.en: a writer whose work is published in a magazine, newspaper, or book

example.en: He works as a contributor for a business magazine.
example.zh: 他是一家商业杂志的撰稿人。

senses.en: funny; causing laughter

example.en: The film has some comic moments.
example.zh: 这部电影有一些滑稽的片段。

senses.en: relating to comedy

example.en: She is known for her comic timing.
example.zh: 她以喜剧节奏感著称。

senses.en: a magazine or book of illustrated stories, usually in strips

example.en: He reads comics every weekend.
example.zh: 他每个周末都看漫画。

senses.en: a comedian; a performer who tells jokes

example.en: The comic had the audience laughing all night.
example.zh: 这位喜剧演员让观众笑了一整晚。

senses.en: a seaside resort town in northwest England, famous for its tower
senses.zh: 布莱克浦（英格兰西北部海滨城镇）

example.en: We spent our holiday in Blackpool last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天我们在布莱克浦度假。

senses.en: a school class for young children to prepare them for primary school

example.en: My daughter starts kindergarten this fall.
example.zh: 我女儿今年秋天开始上幼儿园。

senses.en: plain and simple, without decoration or comfort

example.en: They stayed in a stark room with only a bed and a chair.
example.zh: 他们住在一个只有一张床和一把椅子的简陋房间里。

senses.en: very clear and obvious, often unpleasant

example.en: There is a stark contrast between the two neighborhoods.
example.zh: 两个社区之间存在着鲜明的对比。

senses.en: completely; totally

example.en: The phone screen went stark white when it froze.
example.zh: 手机死机时屏幕变得全白。

senses.en: coming or going together with something else

example.en: Please read the accompanying instructions carefully.
example.zh: 请仔细阅读随附的说明。

senses.en: relating to the ideas, customs, and arts of a society or group

example.en: The city hosts many cultural events every year.
example.zh: 这座城市每年举办许多文化活动。

senses.en: extremely angry; furious
senses.zh: 狂怒的，气得脸色铁青的

example.en: He was livid when he saw the dent on his car.
example.zh: 他看到车上的凹痕时气得脸色铁青。

senses.en: bluish or grey in color, especially skin from bruising or poor circulation

example.en: The cold left her fingers livid.
example.zh: 寒冷使她的手指发青。

senses.en: shining and glossy

example.en: Her lustrous hair caught the sunlight.
example.zh: 她富有光泽的头发映着阳光。

senses.en: to beat or throb rhythmically

example.en: The dancer felt her heart pulsate with excitement.
example.zh: 舞者感到自己的心跳因激动而怦怦作响。

senses.en: to be full of energy or activity

example.en: The city pulsates with life at night.
example.zh: 夜晚的城市充满活力。

senses.en: very pleasing to taste or smell; rich and sweet

example.en: The peaches were ripe and luscious.
example.zh: 桃子熟了，甘美多汁。

senses.en: having strong physical or sexual appeal

example.en: She wore a luscious red dress.
example.zh: 她穿着一条性感的红裙子。

senses.en: to phone someone

example.en: I'll call you after lunch.
example.zh: 我午饭后给你打电话。

senses.en: to give a name to someone or something

example.en: They called the baby Mia.
example.zh: 他们给婴儿取名米娅。

senses.en: a telephone conversation

example.en: I got a call from my sister.
example.zh: 我接到姐姐的电话。

senses.en: a loud shout or cry

example.en: We heard a call for help.
example.zh: 我们听到了呼救声。

senses.en: to put something with something else

example.en: Add a little salt to the soup.
example.zh: 在汤里加一点盐。

senses.en: to calculate the total of numbers

example.en: If you add three and five, you get eight.
example.zh: 三加五等于八。

senses.en: to say or write more information

example.en: She added that the meeting would start at noon.
example.zh: 她补充说会议将在中午开始。

senses.en: to increase an amount or quality

example.en: The new chairs add color to the room.
example.zh: 这些新椅子给房间增添了色彩。

senses.en: to give all your attention to one thing

example.en: She turned off her phone so she could concentrate on her homework.
example.zh: 她关掉手机，以便专心做作业。

senses.en: to make a liquid or substance stronger by removing water or other material

example.en: Boil the sauce to concentrate the flavor.
example.zh: 把酱汁煮沸以浓缩其风味。

senses.en: a strong liquid or substance made by removing water

example.en: Add a spoonful of tomato concentrate to the soup.
example.zh: 往汤里加一勺番茄浓缩酱。

senses.en: a number or constant multiplied by a variable in a mathematical expression, or a measure of a property

example.en: In the expression 5x, the number 5 is the coefficient of x.
example.zh: 在表达式 5x 中，数字 5 是 x 的系数。

senses.en: unity or support between people who share the same interests or goals

example.en: The workers showed solidarity by refusing to cross the picket line.
example.zh: 工人们通过拒绝越过罢工纠察线展现了团结。

senses.en: the remains of something, especially a ship, that has been destroyed

example.en: Divers explored the wreck of the old ship.
example.zh: 潜水员探索了那艘旧船的残骸。

senses.en: a person or thing in a ruined or damaged state
senses.zh: （健康、精神等）严重受损的人（或物）

example.en: After the exam, he was a nervous wreck.
example.zh: 考试结束后，他紧张得垮掉了。

senses.en: to destroy or badly damage something

example.en: The storm wrecked several boats in the harbor.
example.zh: 暴风雨摧毁了港口里的几艘船。

senses.en: well known for something bad; famous in a bad way
senses.zh: 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的

example.en: The infamous criminal was finally caught by the police.
example.zh: 那个臭名昭著的罪犯终于被警方抓获。

senses.en: not supporting either side in a dispute or war
senses.zh: 中立的；不偏袒任何一方的

example.en: Switzerland stayed neutral during both world wars.
example.zh: 瑞士在两次世界大战期间保持中立。

senses.en: not showing strong feelings or taking a clear position; impartial

example.en: Try to keep a neutral tone when giving feedback.
example.zh: 给出反馈时尽量保持中立的语气。

senses.en: chemically neither acidic nor basic
senses.zh: 中性的（化学上非酸非碱）

example.en: Pure water has a neutral pH of about 7.
example.zh: 纯水的pH约为7，呈中性。

senses.en: a person or country that does not side with any party in a conflict

example.en: The neutrals refused to join either alliance.
example.zh: 中立国拒绝加入任何一方联盟。

senses.en: a light, gentle wind

example.en: A cool breeze came off the sea.
example.zh: 海上吹来一阵凉风。

senses.en: something very easy to do

example.en: The test was a breeze.
example.zh: 这次考试轻松得很。

senses.en: to move or do something quickly, easily, and confidently
senses.zh: 轻快自如地行动；轻松地完成

example.en: She breezed through the interview.
example.zh: 她轻松地通过了面试。

senses.en: the main law-making body of a country, made up of elected representatives

example.en: Parliament passed a new law last month.
example.zh: 上个月议会通过了一项新法律。

senses.en: the period during which a particular parliament meets, counted by number (British usage)

example.en: The bill was introduced early in the new parliament.
example.zh: 该法案在新一届议会初期被提出。

senses.en: smooth and shiny

example.en: The photos were printed on glossy paper.
example.zh: 这些照片印在光面纸上。

senses.en: expensively produced and attractive-looking but often superficial

example.en: He works for a glossy fashion magazine.
example.zh: 他在一家印刷精美的时尚杂志社工作。

senses.en: friendly and sociable

example.en: She is outgoing and makes friends easily.
example.zh: 她性格外向，很容易交到朋友。

senses.en: leaving or about to leave a position

example.en: The outgoing president gave a farewell speech.
example.zh: 即将卸任的总统发表了告别演说。

senses.en: (British, usually plural) money regularly spent

example.en: Rent is their biggest monthly outgoing.
example.zh: 房租是他们每月最大的开支。

senses.en: a yellow chemical element found in minerals and volcanic areas

example.en: Yellow sulfur deposits can be found near volcanoes.
example.zh: 火山附近可以发现黄色的硫磺矿藏。

senses.en: to treat something with sulfur to preserve it

example.en: Farmers once sulfured dried fruit to keep its color.
example.zh: 农民曾用硫磺处理果干以保持颜色。

senses.en: money or property donated to an institution to provide ongoing income

example.en: The university's endowment funds scholarships for students.
example.zh: 该大学的捐赠基金为学生提供奖学金。

senses.en: a natural ability or quality that someone has

example.en: She has a remarkable endowment for languages.
example.zh: 她有非凡的语言天赋。

senses.en: clothing, especially of a particular style or for a special occasion

example.en: The guests arrived in formal attire.
example.zh: 客人们身着正装到场。

senses.en: to dress someone in fine or special clothes

example.en: The actor was attired in a silk robe for the scene.
example.zh: 这名演员为这场戏穿上了丝质长袍。

senses.en: having a thin metallic sound, like tin

example.en: The old radio had a tinny sound.
example.zh: 那台旧收音机的声音尖细单薄。

senses.en: of very poor quality; flimsy

example.en: The shelf was made of tinny metal and soon bent.
example.zh: 架子是用劣质薄金属做的，很快就弯了。

senses.en: a mechanical device with a toothed wheel that permits movement in only one direction

example.en: The ratchet prevents the strap from slipping backward.
example.zh: 棘轮防止带子向后滑。

senses.en: to increase or move in small steps, usually in one direction
senses.zh: 逐步提高；（一档一档地）上调

example.en: The company keeps ratcheting up prices every year.
example.zh: 公司每年都在逐步上调价格。

senses.en: the distance from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other

example.en: An eagle can have a wingspan of over two meters.
example.zh: 鹰的翼展可以超过两米。

senses.en: done using physical force or power

example.en: The police made a forcible entry into the building.
example.zh: 警察强行进入了大楼。

senses.en: to steal goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer

example.en: He was caught trying to shoplift clothes from the store.
example.zh: 他试图在商店偷衣服时被抓住了。

senses.en: a metric unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter

example.en: The insect was only a few millimeters long.
example.zh: 这只昆虫只有几毫米长。

senses.en: the farthest end or point of something

example.en: Cold weather can numb the extremities such as fingers and toes.
example.zh: 寒冷的天气会让手指和脚趾等末端麻木。

senses.en: a state of great difficulty or distress

example.en: In moments of extremity, people often discover unexpected strength.
example.zh: 在绝境时刻，人们常常会发现意想不到的力量。

senses.en: an extreme degree or quality

example.en: The scandal was an extremity the company had never faced before.
example.zh: 这起丑闻是该公司从未经历过的极端情况。

senses.en: in an orderly, careful, systematic way

example.en: She methodically checked every item on the list.
example.zh: 她有条不紊地核对了清单上的每一项。

senses.en: to argue over a price or terms before agreeing
senses.zh: 讨价还价，争论（价格、条件）

example.en: She haggled with the vendor over the price of the rug.
example.zh: 她和摊贩就地毯的价格讨价还价。

senses.en: an argument over a price or terms

example.en: After a long haggle, they agreed on a fair price.
example.zh: 经过一番讨价还价，他们商定了一个公道的价格。

senses.en: a very large vulture living in the Americas, one of the largest flying birds

example.en: A condor soared high above the canyon.
example.zh: 一只秃鹫在峡谷上空高高翱翔。

senses.en: money gained in business after paying all costs

example.en: The company's profits rose sharply this year.
example.zh: 公司今年的利润大幅增长。

senses.en: to gain money or benefit from something

example.en: Small businesses profited from the new tax policy.
example.zh: 小企业从新税收政策中获益。
